patch_description: Replace the three independent single-qubit rotation layers with per-qubit RZ–RY–RZ Euler rotations placed before the existing CZ entanglers. This preserves 24 parameters per block and comparable gate count while providing full local SU(2) expressivity, improving parameter efficiency and allowing each re-uploaded feature state to be oriented optimally before entanglement.
